note: A-10C. Pods (LITENING, Sniper, ALQ-131, ALQ-184) join with their stores (ADR-30, MS-7). Its radar warning receiver is not named in a source found.

payloads.name: gun
evidence: GAU-8/A Avenger rotary cannon with 1,174 rounds

payloads.name: stations
payloads.note: eight under the wings, three under the fuselage

payloads.name: link16
evidence: a modern communications suite including a Link 16 radio and Satcom

payloads.name: cmds
evidence: it carries both flares and chaff cartridges

loadouts.name: self-defence
loadouts.note: the article's 'two AIM-9 Sidewinder air-to-air missiles for self-defense under the other wing' (an ALQ-131 pod under one): two AIM-9M on the right outboard station's dual rail

loadouts.name: external tanks
loadouts.note: three 600 US gal tanks on 4, 6, 8 (DCS's stations: a game reference) (ADR-30, MS-7g: a tank's fuel feeds the aircraft's own tanks; jettisoned, it flies on with what is left)

loadouts.name: pods
loadouts.note: the article's ALQ-131 under one wing (its Sidewinders under the other), a LITENING under the right (which station: assumed) (ADR-30, MS-7g: a pod as a store - its mass and its drag on the aircraft; what it senses or jams is its payload's, not built with it yet)
